product_summary: Website (jaganlamps.com, Home/About/Products/Halogen/Miniature/Xenon-HID pages) shows a Kundli (Sonipat, Haryana) plant, IATF 16949, claiming Tier-1 OEM supply and export to '45+ countries' (About page says '70 countries' — internally inconsistent). Core manufactured lines: 12V/24V halogen headlight bulbs (H1, H4, H7, H11, HB3/HB4; Night Fighter 100/150/200, Ultra Blue, Xenon Blue, Standard, Wheeler, Auxiliary), LED retrofit and LED signalling lamps, Xenon HID lamps, miniature lamps (indicators, dashboard, number plate, interior), headlamp assemblies, plus auxiliary/fog lamps. The Products page additionally lists non-lighting items presented as catalogue categories: horns, coolant, engine oils, spark plugs, air/oil/cabin filters, wipers, relay/buzzer/flasher, electrical parts, Android player, ambient light, dash cam, GPS tracker, tire inflator, car accessories. Aviation is claimed in the About/Home text ('aviation', 'Miniature Automotive & Aviation Bulbs' page title) but no aviation-specific product or part number is shown.
role_hint: manufacturer (lighting) with trader signs on the accessory lines — horns, filters, oils, coolant, spark plugs, wipers, electronics are listed as catalogue categories with no manufacturing evidence, typical of bought-in trading assortment; no customs line available to separate manufactured vs traded.
comment: HS mapping vs declaration: 853921 — EXACT match, corroborated by the halogen bulb range (H1/H4/H7/H11/HB3/HB4) on the Halogen Lamps page. 851220 — PARTIAL/plausible: covers headlamp assemblies, auxiliary/fog lamps and LED signalling units, but the site does not give a customs line confirming assemblies are actually exported under 8512.20 rather than the bulbs under 8539.21. 870899 — WRONG/unsupported for the core business: the company is a lamp maker; 8708.99 would only fit the traded non-lighting accessories (wipers, horns, filters) and even then is a stretch, since filters are 8421, horns 8512.30, wipers 8512.40. Missing from the declaration: 853929 (miniature/indicator/dashboard bulbs), 8512.10/8512.30/8512.40 (LED signalling, horns, wipers), 8539.10 (sealed beam / auxiliary lamps), and the whole traded accessory block (oils 2710/3403, coolant 3820, spark plugs 8511.10, filters 8421, electronics 8504/8517/8526). Industry label 'Авиастроение и транспорт' (aviation & transport) is a MISCLASSIFICATION: the company is automotive lighting (transport), aviation is only a marketing mention with no aviation product, part number or certification shown — no aviation HS line (e.g. 9405 for aircraft lamps) is supported. Trader signs: the accessory categories on /products are catalogue listings without manufacturing description, unlike the lighting lines which have process/QC detail. Per project rule 3, the HS mismatch is not a rejection ground — company retained, codes to be corrected to 8539.21 as primary with 8512.20/8539.29 added and 8708.99 removed or narrowed. All product claims here are from the company's own website only; no customs line was checked in this task, therefore every product line is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' at the shipment level. Revenue, export volume, CIN/PAN and shipment records: null — not researched in this role.
